# Business case: RepairLog

## Pricing
One plan: 59 PLN/month per shop. Price tested in E-1 (F-3).

## Scenarios (month 6)
| | low | base | high |
|---|---|---|---|
| paying shops | 15 | 40 | 80 |
| revenue (PLN) | 885 | 2,360 | 4,720 |

## Break-even
25 shops against 1,450 PLN/month costs.

## Key assumptions
| ID | Statement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| A-2 | Monthly churn stays under 5% | count cancellations in the first 3 months after launch |
